TALLY ​

A finance platform built to learn by doing ​

TALLY is a local-first finance platform and solo, part-time learning project. It explores how domain language, accounting integrity, modular architecture, and operational evidence fit together in a working product.

The repository’s specifications are the authority; this site is a concise public guide to the thinking and current progress.

Explore TALLY ​

  • Architecture: the approved modular-monolith shape and ownership boundaries.
  • Roadmap and progress: milestones, stopping points, and current delivery evidence.
  • Local development: the commands used to build and test the repository.
  • Finance integrity: the principles that protect established financial facts.
  • Learning notes and decisions: practical lessons and selected design choices.
